name: Bydgoszcz

queries.query: Bydgoszcz official cadastral map parcels geoportal API
queries.result: First-party results identified the City of Bydgoszcz geodesy/cadastre procedure page and GUGiK Geoportal EGiB/ULDK documentation. The municipal page states that cadastral materials are available through Geoportal Krajowy and WMS/WFS services for city code 0461.

queries.query: Bydgoszcz oficjalna mapa katastralna działki ewidencyjne geoportal WFS
queries.result: First-party Polish results identified the official Urząd Miasta Bydgoszczy page for Powiatowy Zasób Geodezyjny i Kartograficzny and the GUGiK EGiB service. The page distinguishes the local municipal custodian from the national Geoportal delivery channel and gives TERYT county/city code 0461.

registryBasis: The official City of Bydgoszcz page evidences the local geodesy/cadastre custodian and states that cadastral materials are available through Geoportal Krajowy and WMS/WFS services for city code 0461. GUGiK provides the public ULDK/EGiB delivery service.

officialSources.observation: Official local procedure page identifies public cadastral-material access and city code 0461 WMS/WFS routes.
Official EGiB page documents ULDK and public parcel geometry/identifier delivery through county WFS where available.
Official API documentation defines GetParcelByXY, safe identity fields, geometry output, and EPSG:2180/EPSG:4326 behavior.

runtimeAssessment.reason: A live public source and one safe parcel response are evidenced, but research completion is not adapter admission or independent serial runtime qualification.

pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point retained exactly in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate adjustment was made.
